tips.text: Keep 500 Ducats and 220,000 credits banked so you can buy it the moment Baro stocks it.
Crack relics in a full squad of four and take the highest-Ducat reward; solo runs are faster but pay less each.
Skip Aya for Ducats at Varzia; players call 5 Ducats per Aya a terrible rate.
Check his stock the day Baro lands; he leaves after 48 hours and may skip it next visit.
Players treat it as a Mastery buy rather than a power pick.
Nobody minds the Ducats; the only frustration is waiting for Baro to stock it.
